lines.text: Put it away. We came down here to get away from that.
Sit with us. Nobody here asks about your shift, and nobody upstairs asks about this bar.
Truce, friend. I drink here so I don't have to see you anywhere else.
A Wake on the Row. Stay near the Stair. That's what we do.
Best glass on the Row and the shortest walk home. You pay for both.

barks.text: Two flights up and you're back under Warden blue. That's the whole charm.
Ring's bright tonight. Somebody's salvage bill just went up.
You want the Halo? Far end of the street. We don't go that far.
Nobody upstairs knows I come down here. Everybody upstairs comes down here.
Badge stays in the coat pocket. The coat stays on.
